jefferson-sovc-2020: Jefferson County Clerk: Statement of Votes Cast, 2020 General Election (official results, certified November 10, 2020)
sos-results: Kentucky State Board of Elections: Official 2020 General Election Results

notes: From the clerk's Past Election Results page (jeffersoncountyclerk.org); the State Board of Elections' copy of Jefferson County's report is a scan. Printed sideways, a table to a page: each contest's candidates across, precincts down, a Totals row closing each table; read here by where each figure stands, and every table's precincts add up to its Totals row. Its 'Write-in Totals' line holds every write-in vote, counted or not, so it is not stored; the declared write-in candidates' votes are its write-in list at the end (county totals).

The Secretary of State's county-by-county results, as the State Board of Elections publishes them on its results page for the year: one section a contest, a row for each county it reaches and a Total Votes row. Every section stored here was read only because each of its columns adds up to its Total Votes row and each county is printed once in it. Linked as 'Certified Election Results' on the Board's 2020 page; posted November 20, 2020 (its server's date).
